answer: Lock 94 POA away per mask and a farm of 167 masks has 15698 POA frozen before the epoch opens. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. A single trial, a single mark: the trial is Meal packer spelt meal milled at the millpond, the mark is each spelt is a grist count weighed beside the makers mark, and the panel accepts nothing else. Honest work runs 8 minutes a proof; the farm needs 167 proofs, which is 1336 minutes it cannot paint. Ask the panel what it trusts: the ledge it can verify, the karst it can count, the saffron it can date — and the farm offers none of the three.
